chapter_seo_title: Chapter 128: Who? - Li Huowang Discovers a Letter With His Name | Dao Gui Yi Xian
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finds a bloodstained letter bearing his own name in a town full of skeletons. Can he trust the evidence? Or is the monster real?
og_description: After a desperate forensic investigation, Li Huowang finds a name written in blood that breaks him.
twitter_description: Li Huowang inspects a town's worth of skeletons only to find his own name on a letter. The horror is in the signature.
